subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw add a validated host-path remapping contract for Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox managed mounts, or keep the current identical host/container path requirement as the supported contract?
rationale: The choice changes sandbox bind-source trust boundaries, operator setup compatibility, and whether the durable fix needs config/schema/doctor support, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
options.body: Add or sponsor validated host-path mapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, and browser mounts, with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

options.title: Keep Identical-Path Contract
options.body: Document and enforce that Docker Gateway deployments must mount the same host path inside the Gateway container and add diagnostic guidance for mismatched setups.

options.title: Land Only Narrow Skill Repair
options.body: Treat the open materialized-skills PR as a partial fix while leaving this canonical workspaceAccess issue open for the broader managed-mount contract.

recommendation.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
recommendation.body: Add or sponsor validated host-path mapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, and browser mounts, with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They already marked this cluster canonical and have the strongest recent Docker/sandbox routing signal among the likely owners.
